kb.transfer.title: Move to another computer
kb.transfer.hint: Export everything into one file, or bring in a file made on another device.
kb.transfer.export.title: Export
kb.transfer.export.hint: Packs the original backups, notes, search index and settings into one file you can keep on a disk or copy to another Mac.
kb.transfer.export.warn: The file holds your sessions in full and they are not redacted: they may contain passwords or tokens. Treat it like the data folder itself, and keep it on an encrypted disk (FileVault or an encrypted disk image).
kb.transfer.export.paused: This drive could not pin the files, so collection was paused while the file was written.
kb.transfer.import.title: Import
kb.transfer.import.hint: Bring in a file exported on another device. What you have here is kept; both sides are merged.
kb.transfer.import.choose: Choose a .agentkb file. Nothing changes until you confirm.
kb.transfer.import.adopt: Also take the file's collection interval and digest settings
kb.transfer.import.digestOff: The daily digest is not switched on by an import. Test it in Settings first.
kb.transfer.import.needSpace: Not enough free space: about {{needed}} are needed, {{free}} are free.
kb.transfer.import.previewEmpty: There is no data here yet, so the file is imported as it is: {{sessions}} sessions, {{notes}} notes.
kb.transfer.import.previewMerge: Merged with what is here: {{added}} new sessions; {{same}} already here and identical; {{extended}} continued; {{conflicts}} notes in conflict (the newer is kept, the other saved aside).
kb.transfer.import.previewBoth: {{count}} sessions are kept in both versions.
kb.transfer.import.backupNote: Your current database is backed up first, and nothing here is deleted or overwritten.
kb.transfer.import.done: Imported. {{sessions}} sessions and {{notes}} notes are here now. The daily digest stays as it was; test it in Settings before turning it on.
kb.transfer.import.doneWizard: Imported: {{sessions}} sessions and {{notes}} notes. Check the settings on the last page and finish.
kb.transfer.import.mismatch: Some numbers differ from the file ({{list}}). Every file was checked; run a collection and look again.
kb.transfer.import.warnings: {{count}} warnings were written to the report.

kb.transfer.error.too_new: This file comes from a newer AgentKB. Update this app first. {{message}}

kb.transfer.error.busy: A collection is still running. Try again in a moment.
kb.transfer.error.nothing_to_export: There is nothing to export yet.

kb.transfer.error.not_empty: The data folder changed while importing. Nothing was imported; try again.
kb.transfer.error.cancelled: Cancelled. Your data has not changed.

kb.semantic.title: Semantic search
kb.semantic.hint: Find sessions by meaning, not only by the exact words you remember.
kb.semantic.offline: Everything runs on this computer. The model is downloaded once, and only when you press Download; building the index and searching never use the network, and no session text leaves this computer.
kb.semantic.testFirst: Download the model and pass the test first.
kb.semantic.modelReady: The model is in place and its checksum matches.
kb.semantic.modelCorrupt: The model file {{file}} is damaged ({{reason}}). Delete the model and download it again.
kb.semantic.downloadNote: Downloads {{size}} from the address above and checks it against a checksum built into the app. A file that does not match is deleted.
kb.semantic.testOk: Works: loaded the model and embedded text in {{seconds}} s ({{dim}} numbers per vector).
kb.semantic.indexNone: Not built yet. It fills in by itself after each collection.
kb.semantic.building: Building in the background; the computer stays usable.
kb.semantic.postponed: Put off {{count}} time(s) because the computer is short of memory; it tries again after the next collection.
kb.semantic.indexHint: Takes {{size}} on disk. It can be rebuilt from the backups at any time, so deleting it loses nothing.
kb.transfer.export.withVectors: Include the semantic index (about 25 MB; saves hours of rebuilding on the new computer)
kb.search.semanticBuilding: The semantic index is {{percent}}% built; results may be incomplete.
kb.search.semanticState.model_missing: Semantic search is on but the model is missing: showing keyword results.
kb.search.semanticState.model_corrupt: Semantic search is on but the model file is damaged: showing keyword results.
kb.search.semanticState.index_empty: Semantic search is on but nothing is indexed yet: showing keyword results.
kb.search.semanticState.skipped: Semantic search was skipped for this search (low memory or a filter): showing keyword results.
kb.search.semanticState.error: Semantic search failed: showing keyword results.
kb.transfer.error.embed_running: The semantic index is being built. Try again in a moment (or stop it in the settings).
